text: {"lessons":["I have repeatedly sold stocks just because they were showing a gain; I should use a clear investment plan rather than rush to lock in profits.","Realized gains did not prevent my account value from falling, so I should assess the whole portfolio and manage downside risk—not focus only on individual winning trades.","Checking and trading frequently can encourage impulsive decisions; I should pause, review my reasons, and avoid trading just to feel active."]}
